title: feat(vscode): the provider picker and agentCommand setting offer Copilot (provider 'copilot')
description:
Slice 5 of task-59e1d150 (GitHub Copilot CLI as a fifth agent provider): VS Code parity with the JetBrains slice. dependsOn task-ab323f85: the wrappers run copilot for -Command copilot / --command copilot.

DELIVERABLE:
- 'copilot' in AgentProvider (moe-vscode/src/util/AgentLauncher.ts). A copilot launch passes -Command 'copilot' / --command 'copilot' like the other providers.
- pickProvider in moe-vscode/src/extension.ts lists { label: 'Copilot', provider: 'copilot' } before Custom...
- The agentCommands datalist in moe-vscode/src/panels/SettingsPanel.ts offers copilot.
- 'COPILOT' in WorkerType (moe-vscode/src/types/moe.ts).
- Tests: moe-vscode/tests/verified-local-launch.test.cjs V5 refuses 'copilot' worker and QA VM seats by name before any readiness request (vmSeatsMayLaunch allows only claude and codex), plus a check that the picker and the datalist offer copilot.

NOT IN SCOPE: isAgentAuthor's name heuristics (worker ids are <role>-<hex>, never the CLI name); the VS Code listing text (package.json description, README: the docs slice); JetBrains.

VERIFICATION (global rail: never npm ci/install/test in the live checkout): in a snapshot outside the repo, moe-vscode's npm ci, npm test and npm run compile all pass (the plan names any daemon or proxy build the startup tests need).

implementationPlan.description:
Add 'copilot' before 'custom' to the exported AgentProvider union and 'COPILOT' to WorkerType; no daemon/wire schema change or worker-name heuristics. The production launcher already uses `command = provider` for every non-custom provider and both command builders quote that string, so do not add a Copilot-only branch or change quoting helpers. Keep VM_AGENT_COMMANDS as ['claude','codex'] and vmSeatsMayLaunch refusal before readiness unchanged.
Use test-driven-development in verified-local-launch.test.cjs. Extend V5's unsupported-provider table with ['copilot', undefined, 'copilot'] and run each row for BOTH worker and qa. The exact assertion remains `assert.deepEqual([f.errors,f.terminals.length,ask.calls],[[CLI_REFUSAL(shown)],0,0])`; a ready daemon reply must still not be queried. Add host launch cases with legacy/observe for Copilot, all roles; exact decoded terminal command must carry -Command 'copilot' on Windows or --command 'copilot' on POSIX and no provider-specific exec/positive interactive flags. Exercise both builders on every host: minimally parameterize the existing launcher VM harness with optional simulated process.platform, use Object.create(process,{platform:{value:platform}}) as agent-launcher-controls.test.cjs already does, and create both fake bundled wrapper files for those cases; leave default callers/fixtures intact. Compare full decoded command/terminal options, only normalizing the random seat id, not dropping meaningful argv. Add a TypeScript AST assertion on the exported WorkerType union that 'COPILOT' is present exactly once, since runtime transpilation erases the type. Preserve all old union members. Error handling: existing missing custom command, unsafe arg, missing wrapper and VM refusal paths stay unchanged; no real sockets or installed Copilot needed.

implementationPlan.description:
In pickProvider's existing providers array add `{ label: 'Copilot', description: lastProvider === 'copilot' ? 'Last used' : '', provider: 'copilot' }` immediately before Custom.... Keep the existing last-used promotion, cancellation and state persistence untouched (base order is before Custom, but a saved provider may move to the top). In SettingsPanel's agentCommands datalist add `<option value="copilot">` after grok; preserve escaping and custom text input. No listing/package/docs edits.
Add focused production-derived tests in verified-local-launch.test.cjs, not a new test file. For picker coverage, use the installed TypeScript AST API to locate the ONE nested FunctionDeclaration named pickProvider in extension.ts, assert exactly one match, transpile its actual `export ` + getText source and run with the existing VM loader plus a vscode.window.showQuickPick recorder and workspaceState stub. With default lastProvider assert the captured labels/providers include Copilot exactly once before Custom, selection returns provider:'copilot', updates moe.lastProvider, and never asks for a custom command. With lastProvider:'copilot', assert it moves first and is marked Last used; cancel returns undefined without a state update. This executes the production function body without activating the whole extension or duplicating its provider table.
For settings coverage transpile the full SettingsPanel module (its runtime import is only vscode); call the existing getWebviewContent on an object created from its prototype with only panel.webview.asWebviewUri/cspSource and extensionUri supplied, and a vscode.Uri.joinPath stub. Inspect the actual emitted `<datalist id="agentCommands">` body for exactly one option value copilot and retain all four previous options. Do not assert a source substring outside the emitted datalist, and do not hand-copy expected HTML into a fixture. These tests must fail when the real picker row or real option is removed.
